title: Update an installation by hand (signed release)
purpose: Updates a PIM Manager installation by hand: it reads Invardia's signed release for this edition and ring, verifies it exactly as the in-cloud updater does, and only with -Apply downloads the release, checks its size and SHA-256, and deploys it with the parameters the last successful deploy saved.
whenToRun: When you keep the in-cloud updater off (deployed with -SkipUpdater) and update on your own schedule -- Community or Pro. The in-cloud updater is the default and checks the same signed release at night. Run it from the folder of the release you installed (.\tools\setup\Update-PimCommunity.ps1), as the person who ran the original deploy.

runAs.name: The same rights as the original deploy (Invoke-PimDeployAll.ps1): Owner of the PIM resource group or subscription, signed in through the browser (no Azure CLI)
runAs.scope: the PIM resource group and subscription
runAs.why: The update runs the release's deploy with the saved parameters; every step that is already current is skipped, so in practice it rolls the new version and upgrades the schema. The deploy's own page lists each right.

changes.object: a new folder PIM4EntraPS-<version> next to the current one, holding the verified release -- only with -Apply and when a newer release is approved for the ring
changes.why: The release is unpacked from the archive whose size and SHA-256 match the signed manifest, never from an unchecked download.
changes.undo: Delete the folder; the previous release folder is untouched.

changes.object: the PIM Manager / engine containers, the database schema (additive) and any step the deploy finds out of date -- only with -Apply
changes.why: Rolls the new version. The schema is upgraded additively before the new version starts, and a failed health check rolls the Manager back.
changes.undo: Run the previous release folder's Update-PimCommunity.ps1 -SkipPull -Apply; the deploy rolls that version back in.

parameters.name: TenantId
parameters.help: Which saved deploy profile to use when there is more than one on this machine.

parameters.name: ProfilePath
parameters.help: A saved deploy profile to use directly (written by a successful Invoke-PimDeployAll.ps1 -Apply).

parameters.name: SkipPull
parameters.help: Re-run the deploy on the code you already have (no release is read or downloaded).

parameters.name: Apply
parameters.help: Download the verified release and deploy it. Without it nothing changes: the target version is reported and the deploy plan printed.

parameters.name: AcceptBaselineChange
parameters.help: Accept a new version that changes the policy baseline. The update refuses such a version and names this switch; give it for that one run when the change is intended. It is never saved into the profile.

parameters.name: Edition
parameters.help: Community (Invardia's anonymous Community channel) or Pro (the licence feed: needs -InstallKey and -LicencePath).

parameters.name: Ring
parameters.help: The release ring to follow; 3 is the public release (the Community channel serves rings 2 and 3).

parameters.name: InstallKey
parameters.help: Pro only: this installation's Invardia install key (Settings > Licence).

parameters.name: LicencePath
parameters.help: Pro only: the Invardia-issued licence file.

parameters.name: AllowMajor
parameters.help: Take a MAJOR version jump on purpose; refused otherwise.

parameters.name: DeployArgs
parameters.help: Extra parameters for the release's deploy (a hashtable), for a parameter a newer release added. Never saved.

readsOnly: the saved deploy profile (%LOCALAPPDATA%\pim\deploy-profiles\<tenant>-*.json, or -ProfilePath) and the applied-release record next to it
Invardia's signed release for the edition and ring (read-only), to report from -> to
network: invardia.com (the signed release: GET /api/updates/pim-manager/community/<ring>, anonymous; Pro: the licence feed)
github.com (the release archive the signed manifest names -- only with -Apply)
login.microsoftonline.com, management.azure.com, graph.microsoft.com and the PIM resources (the deploy; see Invoke-PimDeployAll)
whatIf: Reads the saved profile and reports the version; with -SkipPull reads nothing else ('no pull -- -SkipPull'); runs the deploy as a -WhatIf plan ('DEPLOY-ALL PLAN (WHATIF ...', 'WHATIF / PLAN-ONLY -- no changes made'). -WhatIf wins over -Apply: nothing is downloaded. Nothing is changed.
undo: Run the previous release folder's Update-PimCommunity.ps1 -SkipPull -Apply; the deploy rolls that version back in.
